Export Officer Job at GZ Industries




        
    

        
        GZ Industries is West Africa's leading aluminum can manufacturer, rapidly expanding to sub-Saharan Africa. GZI is an indigenous Company owned by: Standard Chartered Private Equity, a group of four individual investors, Verod Capital Management, and Ashmore Private Equity.

We are recruiting to fill the position below: 

 Job Position: Export Officer

Job Location: GZI-Agbara, Ogun
Employment Type: Full Time (Onsite)

Job Description
     

            
    




	To manage and coordinate the end-to-end export process, ensuring timely, cost-effective, and compliant shipment of finished goods, raw and packaging materials and recyclable materials to international customers while adhering to Nigerian export regulations and global trade requirements.


Roles & Responsibilities


	Plan, coordinate and execute all export shipments via sea, air, or road freight.
	Manage the complete export cycle from order receipt through delivery to international customers.
	Ensure export orders are processed and shipped in accordance with customer requirements and agreed timelines.
	Coordinate cargo loading, container stuffing, and shipment scheduling with logistics service providers.
	Prepare and process all export documentation including: Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Proforma Invoice, Form NXP, Certificate of Origin, Clean Certificate of Inspection (CCI), Bill of Lading, and relevant export permits and licences.
	Ensure compliance with the Nigeria Customs Service (NCS), Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN), Nigerian Export Promotion Council (NEPC), Pre-Shipment Inspection Agencies, and Port Authorities.
	Coordinate activities of freight forwarders, shipping lines, customs agents, and transport providers.
	Ensure efficient port operations and minimize delays.
	Maintain strong working relationships with shipping lines, freight forwarders, customs brokers, banks, and government agencies.
	Monitor export logistics costs and ensure compliance with approved budgets.
	Identify opportunities to improve export processes.
	Support digitization and automation EAN initiatives within export operations.


Requirements


	Education: Bachelor's Degree or HND in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Maritime Studies, International Trade, Economics, or a related discipline.
	Experience: Must have 3-5 years' experience in export logistics, shipping, freight forwarding, or international trade.


What We Offer


	Exceptional Employee Experience
	Growth Opportunities
	Competitive Renumeration
	Supportive team culture
	Inclusive Workplace


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV  to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email

title: Logistics Officer Job at R & R Recruiting Services
content:
R & R Recruiting Services is a Recruitment Agency, Training, Consulting & Human Resources Management.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Logistics Officer

Job Location: Lagos (Frequent Travel Required)
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Coordinate inbound procurement materials and outbound goods.
	Oversee warehousing, fleet management, and last-mile delivery.
	Coordinate vendors and ensure timely delivery to clients nationwide.
	Monitor inventory and distribution activities.
	Optimize delivery routes and ensure smooth logistics operations.


Requirements


	3–5 years of experience in Logistics/Supply Chain, preferably within the Oil & Gas sector.
	Strong knowledge of inventory control, vendor coordination, and route optimization.
	Experience managing distribution networks and bulk products.
	Good organizational and communication skills.
	Must be willing to travel frequently.


Salary
N150,000 + Out-of-Station Allowance.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Note: For more enquiries, WhatsApp 09035411252.    

    

        Click here to Apply
